UP CM Yogi Adityanath Responds to Akhilesh Yadav's 'Infiltrator' Remark

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath responded to a statement by Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, who had referred to certain individuals as 'infiltrators'. Adityanath retorted that if the 'sons of Uttarakhand' had not been present, Yadav might have been grazing buffaloes in Saifai. The exchange occurred in the context of political discourse between the two leaders.
